description: > became >=, so a coupon is treated as expired on its last valid day.

mutation.old: return self.expires_on is not None and today > self.expires_on
mutation.new: return self.expires_on is not None and today >= self.expires_on

report_specific: A coupon with expires_on 2025-03-15 is rejected as expired when it is used on 2025-03-15. It should still work on its last day and only fail from 2025-03-16.
report_vague: A customer says their discount code stopped working on the very day it was supposed to end.
